# TikTok

> > TikTok is a leading short-form video platform offering creative tools for users, advertising solutions for businesses, and safety resources for communities worldwide.

TikTok provides a comprehensive ecosystem including TikTok for Business (advertising platform with Ads Manager, Creator Marketplace, and Creative Center), TikTok Shop for commerce, and extensive safety and well-being resources. The platform enables brands to leverage Branded Hashtag Challenges, influencer partnerships, and performance marketing to reach diverse audiences through the For You feed.

## Key Topics

- TikTok for Business
- Ads Manager
- Branded Hashtag Challenge
- Creator Marketplace
- For You feed
- Brand awareness campaigns
- Performance marketing
- User-generated content
- Influencer partnerships
- Customer acquisition
- TikTok Shop
- Creative Center
- Video marketing
- Digital well-being
- Community safety

## Safety and Well-being

- [Well-being guide](https://www.tiktok.com/safety/en-sg/well-being): Digital well-being guide with Internet Matters for healthy TikTok use
- [Bullying prevention](https://www.tiktok.com/safety/en-us/bullying-prevention): Bullying and harassment prevention guide with reporting features

## Brand Success Stories - Entertainment & Gaming

- [NBA 2K | TikTok for Business Case Study](https://www.tiktok.com/business/en-SG/inspiration/nba-2k-360): NBA 2K Branded Hashtag Challenge case study with Zion Williamson
- [VYS Games | TikTok for Business Case Study](https://www.tiktok.com/business/en-SG/inspiration/vys-games-206): VYS Games mobile game marketing creating authentic interest
- [Parc Asterix | TikTok for Business Case Study](https://www.tiktok.com/business/en-SG/inspiration/parc-asterix-202): Parc Asterix theme park account launch and brand engagement campaign

## Brand Success Stories - Consumer Goods & Retail

- [Little Moons | TikTok for Business Case Study](https://www.tiktok.com/business/en-SG/inspiration/little-moons-214): Little Moons UK viral campaign driving mass awareness and engagement

## Brand Success Stories - Services & Finance
